scope: Minimal local PostgreSQL diagnostic; excludes HTTP, Prisma, incident engine, automation, random payloads and application indexes. Not application throughput certification.
payload: 10,000 repeated x characters in JSONB; compressible
script: BEGIN; INSERT one JSONB row; UPDATE one random row among 64 budget counters; COMMIT;
transport: Inside owned PostgreSQL container via Unix socket; no network overhead
limitation: pgbench emitted debug messages during the run; result is diagnostic and not a controlled storage ceiling
